name: The Forest's Bounty

angles.text: As a cook, you can roast Shadowgale acorns into simple forest fare.

aliases: who gives the forest bounty quest
faq.answer: A nervous forager near Shadowgale Forest asks you to gather acorns. They have collected those nearby, but need help reaching woods where dangerous wildlife roams.
faq.q: Who asks you to gather the acorns?

faq.answer: Shadowgale Acorns lie scattered beneath Shadowgale Forest's canopy. Search the forest floor and watch for predators among the trees.
Predatory, raptor-like birds prowl the forest floor. Without martial training, ordinary folk risk danger if they stray far from camp.
faq.q: Why is collecting acorns dangerous here?

faq.answer: The acorns are hearty wild food. Roast them over a fire for a warm snack to share with those willing to brave the forest beasts.
faq.q: What are the acorns used for?

faq.answer: The forager describes dangerous “raptor-bird things” hunting in Shadowgale Forest. These avian or reptilian predators are large and vicious enough to prey on an unwary traveler.
faq.q: What are the raptor-bird creatures mentioned in the forest?

faq.answer: Shadowgale Acorns can be tough or bitter raw. Roasting them over heat makes them a delicious treat.
faq.q: How are the acorns prepared for eating?

sections.body: A cautious forager in Shadowgale Forest has gathered the acorns near safety. Fierce, raptor-like creatures prowl among the trees and keep the forager from reaching the wilder groves. So passing travelers are needed to gather what lies deeper in the woods, and help ensure neither goes hungry.
sections.title: A Perilous Foraging Run

sections.body: Shadowgale Acorns make hearty food when prepared with care. Raw, they can be bitter or tough, but roasting them over a fire turns the wild harvest into a rich treat. To gather them, you must brave the timber where predatory birds prowl.
sections.title: Roasting the Harvest

summary: In Shadowgale Forest, a forager needs help gathering fallen acorns. Raptor-like predators prowl the deeper woods, and the harvest can be roasted into a forest meal.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Forest's Bounty
